summary: Iteration 3 complete: 10/10 new pytest cases PASSED (test_iteration3.py) covering /api/insights/briefing (shape + 401 unauth), /api/insights/draft-reminder (valid invoice returns subject/body/tone in {polite,firm,urgent}/days_overdue, 404 unknown), /api/insights/data-query (non-empty answer with bullets, used_data flag), /api/insights/anomalies (items with id/type/title/detail/severity/module/action), /api/insights/predict-stockout (sku/quantity/velocity_per_day/days_to_zero/severity), /api/migration/sources (8 entries: tally/zoho/quickbooks/sap/marg/busy/csv/pdf), /api/migration/upload (multipart CSV → 4 rows + columns array detected_type=csv), /api/migration/history (sorted desc by ts), /api/migration/{id}/import (status->completed, imported_at set, 404 unknown). Full backend regression: 44/44 tests across iterations 1+2+3 pass. Frontend: BriefingCard renders Risk/Opportunity/Next Action with detailed AI content (data-testid='briefing-card'), briefing-refresh button works. Receivables: 13 'AI Remind' buttons; clicking opens reminder-modal with tone pill, days_overdue, AI subject+body, Edit toggle, reminder-send button. Finance Overview: 6 mec-* checklist items (mec-bank, etc.), toggle works, auto-run-close button works. Inventory Alerts: Stockout Forecast shows 9 Reorder cards with days-to-zero badges. AskAIModal opens and accepts query (request capture inconclusive but backend /insights/data-query works). Settings page: settings-migration testid present and navigates to /settings/migration. Migration page: all 8 source cards visible (Tally/Zoho/QuickBooks/SAP/Marg/Busy/CSV/PDF), target dropdown, file input accept='.csv,.xlsx,.xls,.pdf,.xml,.tsv,.txt,.iif', uploaded test_upload.csv → preview shows columns, run-import works, success toast 'Imported 4 rows from test_upload.csv' appears, history refreshes from 3→4 entries.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 922 lines (up from 664). Strong recommendation to split into routers/ (auth, inventory, finance, insights, migration, drilldown) before next iteration — single-file growth is now a real maintainability risk.
Migration source cards on /settings/migration do NOT have data-testid='source-{id}' attributes — would help future automated tests; cards render and are clickable visually. Minor.
PDF/Excel/XML migration upload paths return placeholder columns/preview only ('AI extraction queued'). Acceptable for prototype but should be flagged to user that no real parsing happens beyond CSV.

/api/insights/predict-stockout uses random fallback velocity when no historical out-moves exist (rng.uniform(2, 14)) — deterministic per process due to Random(11) but reviewer should know severity classification is partly synthetic for new SKUs.
/api/insights/draft-reminder days_overdue computed off due_date even for paid invoices — endpoint should arguably 400 if invoice already paid; currently it drafts a reminder for any invoice. Minor.
/api/migration/upload doesn't validate source/target enum values — accepts any string. Low priority for prototype.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 new iteration-3 cases; 44/44 full regression including iteration 1+2)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of new flows verified: BriefingCard + refresh, Reminder modal (tone/days/subject/body/edit/send), MEC checklist (6 items + auto-run + toggle), Stockout forecast (9 reorder cards), AskAI modal opens, Settings→Migration nav, Migration page (8 sources, dropdown, file input with full accept list, upload→preview→run-import→toast→history refresh)

seed_data_creation: Each backend test run inserts one TEST migration record (TEST_products.csv, csv→products, 4 rows, completed). UI test added 1 more (test_upload.csv). Acceptable per problem statement note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 endpoints stable. Briefing & data-query take 3-8s due to Claude — use timeout>=30s. Multipart upload tests must NOT use a session that has Content-Type: application/json header set (it overrides multipart boundary and FastAPI returns 422 'file required'); use a fresh requests.post() with files= kwarg. Migration source cards on /settings/migration don't carry data-testid='source-{id}' but the 8 source names are present in DOM text. AskAIModal opens reliably; verifying that it hits /insights/data-query (not /insights/generate) requires page.on('request') listener around the submit click. Tone classification: polite (<15d overdue), firm (15-44d), urgent (>=45d). Migration upload accepts: .csv,.xlsx,.xls,.pdf,.xml,.tsv,.txt,.iif. /api/migration/upload supports source/target form fields free-form (no enum validation).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Initial test failure on multipart upload was a test-script issue (session Content-Type: application/json overriding multipart boundary header); fixed by using bare requests.post() instead of the session for the multipart call.
